title: Late comeback
story: Northbridge trail at 70', a tactical sub and a higher press turn it to 3-2.

title: Ten men
story: Redmere lose a defender to a red card on 34'; Harbor break through 1-0.

title: Derby draw
story: A fierce, high-pressing derby: both sides lead, 2-2, plenty of bookings.

title: Press collapse
story: Kestrel press high and lead, then their press collapses after 58' and Harbor win 1-2.

title: The rout
story: Northbridge dominate a struggling Elmstead side 4-0.

title: Set-piece special
story: A tight game settled by a single set-piece goal, 1-0.
